The earthquake at the end of Phase 2

The densely packed houses and narrow lanes of the village's second phase came down together. What followed was a brief patched-up reoccupation, Phase 3, with repairs and a new retaining wall, before Sotira was left for good. It is the clearest destruction horizon in the Cypriot Neolithic and the reason earthquakes are blamed for the end of the Sotira culture.
